response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive software development experience, including C++ at National Instruments, but his recent work heavily focuses on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang, with no clear evidence of recent C++ development on the Windows platform. His domain expertise in capital markets or fixed income is not demonstrated in the resume.
strengths: Strong C++ background from National Instruments with LabWindows/CVI development
Extensive experience in software engineering across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated ability to work in financial-services-like environments (RIDE Capital)
concerns: No recent C++ development on Windows platform (focus shifted to JS/TS, Dlang, Node.js)
Lacks explicit domain expertise in capital markets or fixed income systems
No mention of SQL Server/Oracle or messaging frameworks (Kafka, MQ)
